item.title: Will Trent – “Call Paul”– Review: Killer Imagination
item.description: A Tale of Two TonesWill Trent has been on a creative hot streak, and “Call Paul” keeps the momentum going with an episode that’s equal parts horror film, psychological thriller, and chaotic family reunion.
